title: Link to your privacy policy in the footer
description: Websites that collect any personal data must publish a privacy policy and link to it prominently — this is a legal requirement under GDPR, CCPA, and most other privacy regulations.

documentation.title: GDPR Article 13 - Information to be provided
ICO Privacy notices, transparency and control

title: Show a cookie consent notice
description: Websites that set non-essential cookies must obtain prior, informed user consent under GDPR, CCPA, and similar privacy regulations before cookies are placed.

documentation.title: ICO Guide to PECR - Cookies and similar technologies

title: Avoid third-party cookies
description: Third-party cookies set by external domains track users across sites without their knowledge.
detail: Modern browsers are phasing them out, and regulations like GDPR and CCPA require consent before setting them.

documentation.title: web.dev: Preparing for the end of third-party cookies

title: Collect only the minimum personal data necessary
description: Limit data collection to only what is strictly required for the stated purpose, in line with GDPR Article 5(1)(c) data minimisation principles.

documentation.title: GDPR Article 5 — Principles relating to processing of personal data

title: Implement a user-facing data deletion mechanism
description: Provide users with a clear way to request deletion of their personal data, fulfilling GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure / right to be forgotten).
